result:
Both fixes are implemented, tested, live-deployed, and the PR is open.

**Summary of what shipped** (PR: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/76):

**Fix 1 — self-report backfill** (`scripts/backfill_phase_self_report.py`, new): given a task id, independently confirms a real GitHub merge (never trusts a self-report), then writes `status`/`completed_by_task`/`evidence` into the correct phase-plan entry via a targeted text edit and pushes to master — same fields, same place the two real manual backfills (PRs #559, #560) landed. Wired into `supervisor-entrypoint.sh`'s tier1 merge path and into `auto_phase_continuation.py`'s cron run (`--sweep`) to also cover tier2 (phase_1 was tier2 and was never revisited after a human merged it manually). A retroactive sweep against real production data caught and fixed a genuine indent-schema bug (Auditor Engine's plan file uses a different YAML layout) and confirmed zero remaining gaps system-wide. 14 test scenarios pass.

**Fix 2 — CI-timing race**: `mandatory-audit-check.yml` always runs before the AUDIT comment can exist. Rather than adding an `issue_comment` trigger to compliance-tracker's workflow file (confirmed not deployable — the token lacks the `workflow` OAuth scope), `supervisor-entrypoint.sh` now re-triggers the specific failed run itself via `gh run rerun` right after posting its AUDIT comment. Zero compliance-tracker changes needed. 4 test scenarios pass against the real live script.

Both are live-deployed now (not waiting on this PR to merge), so the in-progress phase_3 task — which I left untouched per the constraints — will hit the fixed code path when it completes.
